vibe: A professional esports platform fused with a luxury writing studio. Linear + Notion + Modern Code Editor.

headings.description: Used for all major section headings, marketing copy, and cinematic moments.

body.description: Used for standard body copy and editor writing.

technical.description: Used for timers, word counts, player stats, rank numbers, and developer-style labels.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Dense data combined with wide breathing room for focus.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6. 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800), rounded-xl. No heavy drop shadows; use inner glows (shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]).
spacing_and_layout.editor_layout: Max-w-prose centered, padding-y 32, complete distraction-free zone, bottom sticky bar for word count and timer.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-900 transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-2

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-md focus:border-zinc-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-500 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600

game_timer.style: font-mono text-3xl md:text-5xl tabular-nums font-medium text-white
game_timer.animation: Smooth scaling on warning (last 1 min). Cinematic red pulse.

editor.style: text-lg md:text-xl leading-relaxed text-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-700 font-sans border-none focus:ring-0 resize-none w-full bg-transparent

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle opacity and bg-color shifts (e.g. bg-zinc-900 to bg-zinc-800).
motion_and_interactions.leaderboard: Staggered entrance animations. Position swap animations using LayoutGroup.
motion_and_interactions.typing: Smooth cursor blinking, distraction-free fade-out of UI when actively typing.

images.description: Sleek modern dark mode 3D abstract background for the landing page.
Cinematic close-up of a glowing mechanical keyboard on a dark desk for writing inspiration/loading screens.
Dark atmospheric esports stage for lobby or match history background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind classes for dark mode explicitly, defaulting the entire app to dark mode.
Implement Shadcn UI heavily customized to remove standard borders and shadows. Use 1px #27272A borders everywhere for the 'Linear' look.
For the Editor page, ensure textarea has no outlines, no borders, and fills available height.
Use framer-motion for round transitions and leaderboard ranking swaps.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for automated testing.
Use JetBrains Mono explicitly for numbers, stats, and timers.
Never use purely transparent headers; use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-md for floating navigations.
